# Mkulima Supply Store Agrovet
> Kenya's trusted online agrovet. Buy certified seeds, fertilisers, pesticides and veterinary supplies online. Fast countrywide delivery. Pay via M-Pesa.

## About
Mkulima Supply Store Agrovet is an online agricultural inputs store based in Ongata Rongai, Nairobi, Kenya. We supply KEPHIS-certified seeds, fertilisers, pesticides, herbicides, and veterinary supplies to farmers across Kenya. All products are genuine and sourced from reputable manufacturers.

- **Phone:** +254 746 403931
- **WhatsApp:** Available
- **Location:** Ongata Rongai, Nairobi, Kenya
- **Delivery:** Countrywide, 24–72 hours
- **Payment:** M-Pesa, Cash on Delivery
- **Website:** https://mkulimasupply.store

## Products & Categories
We stock a wide range of farm inputs across the following categories:

- **Seeds** — KEPHIS-certified hybrid maize seeds, tomato seeds, sunflower seeds, watermelon seeds, vegetable seeds, and more
- **Fertilisers** — DAP, CAN, Urea, NPK blends, foliar feeds, organic fertilisers
- **Pesticides & Herbicides** — Fungicides, insecticides, herbicides, rodenticides for all major crops
- **Veterinary Supplies** — Dewormers, vaccines, antibiotics, tick control, livestock supplements
- **Animal Feeds** — Dairy meal, poultry feeds, pig feeds
- **Farm Tools** — Sprayers, knapsacks, irrigation fittings
